subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Delusion
solution:
The correct answer is "**Reality**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's take a look at the given words:
 
 
• "**Delusion**" means a **false belief or opinion about something or someone, often based on a mental disorder or misunderstanding**.

 
 
• ***Example**: His **delusion **that he was a famous actor was shattered when he realized he was just an extra in the movie.*
 
 
 
• "**Reality**" means the **state of things as they actually exist, rather than how they may appear or might be imagined**.
 
 
• ***Example**: The **reality **of the situation is that we cannot afford to buy a new car.*
